html:
SMTO-SKL-0127 — Slack couldn't find that message

GUID: 5fe8ba7a-23ef-5f6a-af63-07f0997a6e32
Slug: slack-message-not-found
Domain: SKL · Subsystem: slack

What happened

  • SMTO looked for one exact message, but Slack didn't return it. It may have been deleted, be a reply inside a thread, or be in another channel. Nothing was changed.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. Ask the Agent to show recent messages in the channel, and pick the message you mean from that list. SMTO finds a message by its exact posting time in Slack, not by its text.
  2. If the message is a reply in a thread, ask the Agent to open the thread first, then pick the reply. Slack only finds a thread reply when SMTO also knows which thread it belongs to.
  3. Check in Slack that the message still exists and that you're using the right workspace connection. A deleted message, or one in another workspace, can't be found.

What success looks like

  • The Agent shows, or acts on, the message you meant.

If it still fails

  • Select Copy error details and send them, with a link to the message copied from Slack, to the person who manages SMTO. Don't ask SMTO to pick the message by matching its text.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • Slack returned message_not_found, or the exact-timestamp conversations.history/conversations.replies read did not include a message with the requested ts.

What this means

  • Slack reports message_not_found, or bounded exact-message lookup cannot find the requested timestamp in the returned history/thread. The diagnostic performs no Slack request. Inspect the original receipt and operation stage to determine effects; keep workspace, principal and exact channel/message identities fixed during recovery.

Why this can happen

  • Slack reports message_not_found, or bounded exact-message lookup cannot find the requested timestamp in the returned history/thread.

How to diagnose it

  • Inspect channel_id, string ts, parent thread_ts and bounded lookup scope.

How to fix it

  • Verify channel_id and the exact ts (keep its full fractional precision); for a thread reply pass the parent thread_ts so conversations.replies is used. Resolve the message from slack.history or slack.thread under the intended workspace_ref rather than matching by text.
  • Verify exact channel_id and ts. Supply the parent thread_ts when reading a reply.

Retry and execution caution

  • Inspect exact provider state and authority first.

How to verify the fix

  • An authorized exact-message read resolves the intended message without guessing by text.

What not to do

  • Do not expose secrets or blindly replay uncertain mutations.

Technical notes

  • The diagnostic performs no Slack request. Inspect the original receipt and operation stage to determine effects; keep workspace, principal and exact channel/message identities fixed during recovery.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.
